title: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis + SOD1 antisense oligonucleotide (real pipeline claims, Open Targets 26.09, cached 8 Oct 2026)

claims.statement: Input: direction of action is inhibit.
Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis is not in the oncology therapeutic area.
claims.rule: Oncology = therapeutic area 'cancer or benign tumor' in Open Targets.

claims.statement: SOD1 has Mendelian genetic evidence for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (155 records: clingen, eva, genomics_england, orphanet, uniprot_literature).
claims.rule: Mendelian: ClinGen, Gene2Phenotype, Genomics England, Orphanet, UniProt literature, or ClinVar with a pathogenic variant. GWAS: credible set with locus-to-gene score >= 0.5. Somatic: IntOGen, Cancer Gene Census. Strongest wins. 'none' needs every evidence row read and genetic data for the disease.

claims.statement: 1 drug with the same mechanism (SOD1 inhibit) is approved for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: Tofersen.
claims.rule: Same mechanism = same target and same direction of action (unknown direction counts as same). Approval = an FDA, EMA or DailyMed label mapped to the disease ID; salt forms are one drug.

claims.statement: Tofersen with the same mechanism is approved for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
claims.rule: Same mechanism = same target and same direction of action (unknown direction counts as same). Approval = an FDA, EMA or DailyMed label mapped to the disease ID; salt forms are one drug. Related disease = a shared specific therapeutic area (phenotype, biological process, measurement and 'genetic, familial or congenital disease' do not count).

claims.statement: 0 drugs with the same mechanism have an active Phase 3 trial in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
claims.rule: Counted: same mechanism, not approved for this disease, a recruiting or active Phase 3 (or 2/3) trial mapped to the disease ID. Terminated or completed trials are not competitors.

claims.statement: 3 drugs are approved for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: Edaravone, Riluzole, Tofersen.
claims.rule: Approved = an FDA, EMA or DailyMed label mapped to the disease ID. TTD-only and PMDA-only approvals and diagnostic radiotracers are not counted; salt forms are one drug. Zero only if the drug list is complete and has no approval of any kind.

claims.statement: SOD1 is a common essential gene.
